# Cncf Acc Ict Kcsp Reviewer

Review ACC ICT (KCSP) using its official documentation and repository in the Special / Kubernetes Certified Service Provider category. ACC ICT uses Kubernetes to deliver continuity for mission-critical solutions in demanding complex multi-cloud &amp; public-cloud environments. We design, build and maintain these environments and offer training.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
